evidence: Implements BIP 54 consensus validation rules across src/validation.cpp, src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp, and src/consensus/consensus.h.
rationale: Implements proposed soft fork consensus cleanup rules to address long-standing vulnerabilities like timewarp difficulty manipulation, 64-byte transaction Merkle tree ambiguity, and legacy sigops CPU exhaustion. Because the activation is confined to regtest, delay is not category-critical, but implementing and thoroughly vetting the consensus rules in Core provides substantial, strategic value for future network upgrades.
